from donations import load_donations, ROWS
from summary import DonationSummary

MEAN = sum(v for _, v in ROWS) / len(ROWS)


def test_mean_of_stored():
    assert abs(DonationSummary(load_donations()).mean_pounds() - MEAN) < 1e-9


def test_count_of_list():
    assert DonationSummary(list(load_donations())).count() == len(ROWS)
